note: Names, descriptions and grades are the official PlayStation trophy list as reported 18 Nov 2026 (Exophase via Push Square; GTABase and Output Lag lists agree). Guides are written in our own words from the official descriptions plus launch-week mechanics reported by the cited sources; where no method is confirmed at launch the guide says so instead of inventing one. No online trophies exist: every trophy is single-player.

trophies.guide: This pops the moment the other 54 are done, so there is nothing to do directly. Work the roadmap in order — story, then collectibles, then activities, then the 100% cleanup — and this is the last trophy you earn. Keep one manual save from before the final mission in case anything goes sideways.
trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!

trophies.guide: Finish the opening mission Gone Fishing; it is the first story mission and cannot be missed. Play through the intro and the trophy pops when the mission ends. No preparation needed.
trophies.name: Just Like Paradise

trophies.guide: Play through Chapter 1 to its end. Chapter trophies can pop at the start of the next chapter rather than on the final cutscene, so keep playing if it does not appear immediately. Unmissable — but do the Chapter 1 balcony meditation for Positive Mental Attitude before this chapter ends.
trophies.name: Paradise Lost

trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 2. Switching between Jason and Lucia opens up during this chapter, which also unlocks most of the free-roam trophies — the garage app, the Scooter Bros app and partner activities. Just keep playing the story.
trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money

trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 3. Robbery tools and several side activities open up in this chapter, so grab the time-sensitive race against Yago the moment it appears (hourglass icon) and start the jewelry robberies while you are here. Unmissable.
trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!

trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 4. Bank vault robberies unlock near the end of this chapter through an optional mission, so do them before or after the finale — they stay available. Unmissable.
trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma

trophies.guide: Complete the final story mission. Keep a manual save from just before it: there is no mission replay, and a save here also protects the missable meditation trophy if you still need it. This is the only gold story trophy.
trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Breakfast Run. It unlocks as you play the story and cannot be missed. No special approach needed.
trophies.name: Trust

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission The Cartel Heist, a Chapter 3 mission. Play the story and it pops when the mission ends. Unmissable.
trophies.name: Break the Bank

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Child's Play. Story-only and unmissable — it pops when the mission ends.
trophies.name: Family Matters

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Headliners. Story-only and unmissable — it pops when the mission ends.
trophies.name: DWNFALL

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission VCIA Takedown, a Chapter 4 mission. Story-only and unmissable — it pops when the mission ends.
trophies.name: Hi-Jacked

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Operation Savage Glory. Story-only and unmissable — it pops when the mission ends.
trophies.name: Snow Storm

trophies.guide: Reach 100% completion on the in-game checklist (Progress > Stats > 100% Completion, which appears after the story). The checklist covers the story, activities, collectibles and challenges — everything else in this guide feeds it, including 300 stunts, 70 of the 80 challenges and 200 of the 277 vehicle models. Expect around 200 hours for the full platinum run; this gold is the hardest trophy on the list.
trophies.name: A Long Road

trophies.guide: Land 250 stunts: stunt jumps, under-the-bridge flights, knife flights and base jumps all count. Chain them while travelling instead of grinding them at the end, and keep going to 300 — the 100% checklist needs 300. Stunt planes and fast bikes make this far quicker.
trophies.name: Cunning Stunts

trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the 9 activity types once — races, fishing, arcade games, shooting ranges, drone races, bowling, meditation, gym training and the other open-world activities. The in-game activity menu shows what you have tried; sample one of each early so nothing is left to the end.
trophies.name: Master of None

trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges across the two shooting ranges. Learn each range's scoring — accuracy and speed both matter — and replay a challenge until gold; silver does not count. Bring your best rifles and pistols and take your time on the long-range lanes.
trophies.name: The Shootist

trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at every one of the 14 locations. Each location has its own course, so learn the gates and shortcuts per track rather than brute-forcing them. One win per location is enough.
trophies.name: Top Fun

trophies.guide: Win 20 different races — street races, off-road and any other race type all count, as long as each race is a different one. Work through the race list with a fast, well-handling car and avoid repeating a race you already won.
trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos

trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Fishing challenges unlock through the fishing activity; use the right bait for the spot and keep the line tension steady instead of reeling hard. Win once and the trophy pops.
trophies.name: Baited My Tackle

trophies.guide: Complete one arcade game — finish a full game at any arcade cabinet. Pick the shortest game you are good at; you do not need a high score, just a completion.
trophies.name: Stick Fiddler

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Andy. Side-story finales stay open after the credits, so there is no rush — finish Andy's strand whenever it appears. Note that Andy's strand does not count toward Strangers & Freaks.
trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Kenton. Kenton's strand stays available after the story, so finish it in your own time. Unmissable once you play the strand through.
trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Billy. Billy's strand does not count toward Strangers & Freaks, which is why it has its own trophy. Play it through to the finale.
trophies.name: The Lone Rider

trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 stranger mission strands across Leonida. Only some questlines count — Andy's, Billy's and Tyrone's do not, because they have their own trophies — so check the trophy's progress counter after each strand you finish. Do the time-sensitive Chapter 3 race against Yago the moment it appears (hourglass icon) or that strand can stall.
trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Randy. Randy's strand stays open after the credits. Play it through to the finale.
trophies.name: Supply & Demand

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Tyrone. Tyrone's strand does not count toward Strangers & Freaks. Finish it after the story if you like — it stays available.
trophies.name: Spin On This!

trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at all 18 spots across Leonida (10 locations); spots show as purple icons when you are close. Bring your partner every time — each outdoor spot counts twice if you meditate there with both characters. THE missable one: the first spot is Lucia's balcony meditation at home in Chapter 1, offered in the morning after the mission Down to Earth — follow her out to the balcony and accept it, and keep a Chapter 1 manual save until the trophy pops, because there is no mission replay.
trophies.missable_reason: The first meditation spot is Lucia's balcony meditation at home in Chapter 1 and it is gone once Chapter 1 ends. There is no mission replay, so do it in Chapter 1 and keep a manual save until the trophy pops.
trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude

trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt the unique animal for Bret in his Jason-only hunting questline, which sends you after animals through target decks. Take a clean head or heart shot to keep the carcass pristine. Follow Bret's strand until the unique hunt appears.
trophies.name: Fair Game

trophies.guide: Complete 3 collectible card sets by finding cards scattered around Leonida. Cards are a pure collectible hunt — sweep each region systematically and use the in-game collection tracker to see which sets are incomplete. No cards are missable, so take your time.
trophies.name: Don’t Touch My Deck

trophies.guide: Use the WAiNK app at 100 locations around Leonida. WAiNK It as you travel — scan landmarks, shops and sights whenever the prompt appears — and the count builds passively. It pairs naturally with the exploration trophy, so do your scanning on the same trips.
trophies.name: You WAiNKer!

trophies.guide: Complete 50 challenges from the Progress > Challenges list. Many complete on their own while you play, so check the list regularly and mop up the easy ones (driving, combat, exploration) late in the game. The 100% checklist needs 70 of the 80 challenges, so keep going past 50.
trophies.name: One Last Thing

trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Lose a 4-star wanted level with your partner beside you and escape the heat. The easiest setup is a bank vault robbery — it hands you 4 stars immediately — then break line of sight and leave the red heat zone with your partner. The trophy pops once you are clear, not while you are still hiding.
trophies.name: Hot Together

trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Call your partner, then rob 3 shops back-to-back without letting your wanted level drop. If the stars fade and you are only in the red heat zone, the chain breaks — so move fast between shops. Give it about 30 seconds after the third shop; the pop is delayed.
trophies.name: Retail Therapy

trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. Scanning a vehicle with the WAiNK app counts as discovering it, so scan traffic as you drive instead of hunting specific cars. The 100% checklist needs 200 of the 277 base models, so keep scanning past 100.
trophies.name: Whip It Good

trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus — the slow-motion aim you trigger with L3 + R3 while aiming. Pick a group of gang enemies, such as the guards at an illegal operation, and use an assault rifle. Adrenaline extends Focus, so build it up first.
trophies.name: Gunslinger

trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Steal a large passenger plane docked at a boarding bridge at Vice City International Airport — planes parked elsewhere on the airfield do not count, and gates E3 and E4 work. Back out toward the runway, take off, and fly about 1 km away from the airport; the pop is delayed. Save first: the police come fast.
trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can

trophies.guide: Get into a Rhino tank. Tanks are parked on the south side of Mile Zero Air Station, the island at the far southwest of the map. Save first, climb in, and drive and fire until the trophy pops.
trophies.name: Challenging Tank

trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. The Chapter 3 mission Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs gives you the Snap Gun and opens jewelry robberies: use it on a store's locked back door (kicking the door sets off the alarm), find the note with the safe code in the back room, open the safe and leave unseen. Richardson Jewelry & Diamonds in Vice City is a good target — if anyone spots you, reload.
trophies.name: Sneakthief

trophies.guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape. Vaults unlock through That's Where The Money Is, an optional mission near the end of Chapter 4: tail an armored security van to a large bank and get into the vault while the guard has it open. Bring your partner — you cannot carry all the bags alone — and expect a 4-star wanted level on every job. The 100% checklist needs all eight vaults.
trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal

trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. Tail a truck until it stops, hit it, grab the cash and break away before the police box you in. It pairs well with the bank-vault grind in Chapter 4, and the marked bills you steal feed Dime on the Dollar.
trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play

trophies.guide: Explore every area of Leonida — visit each named district, town and stretch of countryside until the map is filled in. Drive the highways and back roads systematically, and let the WAiNK scans and stunt jumps pull you into corners you would otherwise skip.
trophies.name: The Goodtime State

trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an illegal operation belonging to each of the 9 gangs. Operations are marked on the map once you find them; hit one per gang and the trophy pops. The 100% checklist wants all 39 operations, so this pops along the way.
trophies.name: Pest Control

trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. Head to a beachfront bar on Ocean Beach, order a cocktail and take in the view — the trophy is tied to the moment, not to a mission. No confirmed exact spot at launch, so try the main beach bars at sunset if it does not pop at the first one.
trophies.name: In The Beginning…

trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style. This is a story-flavoured stunt moment — drive a car straight through a showroom's glass front and keep going. No confirmed exact trigger at launch; it likely pops during a robbery or rampage moment at a dealership, so try the big showrooms in Vice City.
trophies.name: Capital Offense

trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Follow through at the Kolt & Associates bowling alley — Kingpin Bowling, an illegal operation you visit in Chapter 2. Bring Sticky Bombs and take all three key valuables: the luxury watch in an office, the shotgun on a table, and the contents of the office safe, blown open with a Sticky Bomb. Then escape the police; if you leave something behind, the operation comes back later, so it is not missable.
trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling

trophies.guide: A partnership with mass appeal — Jason and Lucia both reaching maximum Strength. Buy a gym membership and train with your partner there; your partner trains alongside you, so both meters climb together. Keep at it between missions and it pops when the second one maxes out.
trophies.name: Personal Best

trophies.guide: Make 500 choices that change your Criminal Profile. Robberies, fights and other criminal actions feed the counter, so it fills up without a separate grind — just play the game like a criminal and check the profile counter in the Stats menu now and then.
trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder

trophies.guide: Second time's the charm. This secret trophy has no confirmed unlock method at launch — the description points to succeeding on a second attempt at something, so a failed-then-retried activity is the best guess. It will likely pop on its own during normal play; do not grind for it until players confirm the trigger.
trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess

trophies.guide: What the hell just happened? A secret trophy with no confirmed method at launch — the wording points to witnessing something strange, most likely a UFO or other easter-egg event somewhere in Leonida. Keep an eye out while exploring at night and in remote areas; it should pop when the event finds you.
trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There

trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by. Knock someone down by swinging a melee weapon from a moving vehicle. No confirmed exact conditions at launch — try a slow drive-by past a pedestrian with a bat equipped, and expect it to pop once the hit registers as a drive-by rather than a normal melee kill.
trophies.name: Ten Pin

trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts. Marked bills come from bank and payday loan jobs; sell them to your contacts to launder them, and the total is cumulative. Bank vaults are the richest source, so this climbs while you chase Maximum Withdrawal.
trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar

trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops — the total is cumulative across every kind of shop, from clothes to weapons to food. Just play normally and buy what you need; it pops on its own well before the endgame.
trophies.name: Treat Yo Self

trophies.guide: Purchase all garage properties — the eight garages in the Vice City Real Estate app, which unlocks after the Chapter 2 mission Daily Driver. Together they cost about $160,000, and garages the story gives you do not count. Buy garages early: they also give you the space to register cars for On the Spot.
trophies.name: Little Boxes

trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. The Chapter 2 mission Moses opens the app: take a stolen car to Moses, choose Respray, then Register. From Chapter 3 you can also register cars with a standard tracker at Pay 'n' Spray. Each car needs a free garage space, so buy garages first and register cheap cars.
trophies.name: On the Spot
